Rugged rounded cave walls and a low irregular rock ceiling recede into dim shadows; restrained moss in crevices. A faint, soft cool daylight glow filters from an unseen cave entrance off-frame; NO window, NO masonry arch and NO depicted portal. Preserve the composition and quiet mood: the EMPTY small chalk summoning circle remains the clear focal point in the lower middle, viewed as an ellipse in perspective, surrounded by short ivory wax-dripped candles. Every candle is UNLIT, black wick, absolutely no flame or glowing wick. Preserve the professional colored-pencil and graphite crosshatching, fine ink contours, warm neutral stone with plum/teal shadows, portrait 1024x1536 proportion and softly feathered organic edges fading into GENUINE alpha transparency. No people, hero, hands, animals, faces, lettering, labels or book frame. The entire scene must read immediately as inside a cave, not ruins or a castle.
